partial_threshold.name: Partial threshold (PR-01)
partial_threshold.description: Compliance percentage (C%) from which a control moves from Weak to Partial.

weak_threshold.name: Weak threshold (PR-02)
weak_threshold.description: Compliance percentage (C%) from which a control stops being Non-existent and becomes Weak.

asset_coverage.name: Asset coverage (PR-03)
asset_coverage.description: Percentage of assets a technical test must measure to count.

check_exception_max_days.name: Maximum exception duration (PR-04)
check_exception_max_days.description: Maximum days an automatic check exception can last.

freshness_hours.name: Automatic result freshness (PR-05)
freshness_hours.description: Maximum hours an automatic result is considered current.

alert_days_before.name: Alert days by periodicity (PR-06)
alert_days_before.description: Days before the window closes at which an alert is raised, by requirement periodicity.

on_demand_alert_days.name: On-demand alert (PR-06)
on_demand_alert_days.description: Days before the quarter closes at which the declaration of "when required" requirements is requested.

validity_windows.name: Validity windows (PR-07)
validity_windows.description: How evidence expires: by calendar windows (month, quarter, year) or rolling (one periodicity from each evidence date).

risk_partial_mitigation_coverage.name: Partial mitigation coverage (PR-08)
risk_partial_mitigation_coverage.description: Control coverage from which a risk is considered partially mitigated.

risk_demonstrated_mitigation_coverage.name: Demonstrated mitigation coverage (PR-09)
risk_demonstrated_mitigation_coverage.description: Control coverage from which a risk mitigation is demonstrated.

impact_reduction_enabled.name: Impact reduction (PR-10)
impact_reduction_enabled.description: Whether a control can reduce the impact of a risk.

approval_max_steps.name: Maximum approval steps (PR-11)
approval_max_steps.description: Maximum number of steps in a document approval flow.

approval_max_approvers_per_step.name: Maximum approvers per step (PR-12)
approval_max_approvers_per_step.description: Maximum number of approvers in each approval step.

submitter_sole_approver_allowed.name: Submitter as sole approver (PR-13)
submitter_sole_approver_allowed.description: Whether the person submitting a document can be its only approver. It is recorded in the audit trail.

document_acceptance_days.name: Document acceptance period (PR-14)
document_acceptance_days.description: Days people have to accept a published document.

document_acceptance_required.name: Required document acceptance (PR-15)
document_acceptance_required.description: Percentage of people who must accept a document for it to count as accepted.

audited_period_min_months.name: Minimum audited period (PR-16)
audited_period_min_months.description: Minimum months of the audited SOC 2 period.

score_threshold.name: Global score threshold
score_threshold.description: Minimum score (%) for a global-score link to pass.

solid_asset_coverage.name: Asset coverage of a Solid control
solid_asset_coverage.description: Asset coverage (%) a Solid control requires in its technical tests; it cannot be lower than the asset coverage (PR-03).
